description: What they can do right now and why not: the workspace they're in and who they register for, the Business subscription (status, renewal, days left), their wallet (naira), WhatsApp, personal drafts, whether a registration can start in each workspace (and the tool that unblocks it), whether they can add money, and features switched on for them.
